rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that has remained the same.

example.english: The plan is unchanged up to now.
example.jyutping: go3 gai3 waak6 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 mou5 bin3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something was left exactly as it was, without being touched or altered.

example.english: I put your book back on the shelf unchanged.
example.traditional: 你本書我原封不動咁放返喺書架度。
example.jyutping: nei5 bun2 syu1 ngo5 jyun4 fung1 bat1 dung6 gam3 fong3 faan2 hai2 syu1 gaa2 dou6
